_note: All user-facing texts of the interface (NFA-15, E-12). No text belongs in a component. This file is the **base table**: it is always in the bundle, and every other language is laid over it at runtime, so a translation that does not carry a key is answered from here rather than leaving a hole. Placeholders in curly braces are substituted at runtime. A new language is one file beside this one — nothing else.

login.title: Sign in
login.forgotten_hint: This application sends no email. A new password is issued by whoever administers this instance and passed on to you by another route. After signing in with it you will be asked to choose one of your own.

register.title: Create account
register.name: Name
register.password_hint: At least {minimum} characters. Length counts for more than special characters.
register.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
register.approval_notice: Your account will be approved by the administration after it is created. You can sign in once that has happened.
register.closed: On this instance the administration creates the accounts. Get in touch with them if you need access.

setup.title: First-time setup
setup.intro: This instance has no account yet. Create the first one — it receives the administrative rights for the instance.
setup.name: Name
setup.password_hint: At least {minimum} characters. Length counts for more than special characters.
setup.password_mismatch: The two entries do not match.

session.expired_hint: Sign in again. Your entries are kept and the interrupted action carries on afterwards.

error.network: The server cannot be reached. Check that the application is running and try again.
error.unreadable: The answer from the server could not be read. Please reload the page.
error.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please reload the page.

library.title: Library
library.empty_search_hint: There is no prompt for “{term}” in this area.
library.empty_hint: A prompt is a text you use again and again — with placeholders you fill in as you go. There is none here yet.
library.bulk_move_hint: Prompts that are visible to the workspace are set back to private in the process. Releasing them in the target stays a step of its own.
library.bulk_trash_hint: They stay in the trash for 30 days and can be fetched back from there.
library.bulk_refused_unnamed: {count} not dealt with — they are not visible to you.

editor.body_hint: Write {{placeholder}} in curly braces. The fields to fill in come from those — all by themselves.
editor.model_hint_hint: Which model this prompt is meant for. A note only; nothing is steered by it.
editor.title_required: Without a title the prompt cannot be found again later.
editor.body_required: A prompt without text has nothing to copy.
editor.preview_hint: This is how the prompt looks before anybody fills anything in. Dashed placeholders have no default value yet.
editor.variables_none: No variables yet. As soon as {{placeholder}} appears in the text, an entry shows up here.
editor.leave_hint: They will be lost on leaving.
editor.rejected_keys: Not a variable, so no field appears for it: {keys}. A name starts with a letter and holds letters, digits and underscores.

relocate.no_target: There is no workspace of yours in which you may create prompts. Get in touch with whoever manages the workspace you want to work in.
relocate.move_warning: Moving sets the visibility back to “Only me”. Keywords that do not exist in the target are dropped.
relocate.duplicated: Copy created. Give it a name.
relocate.dropped_keywords: These keywords do not exist in the target and were left out: {names}.

prompt.keywords_locked: These keywords belong to the prompt and live in another workspace. They take effect but cannot be switched off here.
prompt.no_variables: This prompt has no variables. The finished text is on the right.
prompt.required_missing: Without this the prompt cannot be copied.
prompt.slot_empty: Placeholder {key} — still empty and not part of the text
prompt.slots_note: Dashed placeholders are still empty. “Copy” leaves them out, “Copy with placeholders” hands over the prompt with all of them.
prompt.copy_raw_hint: Copies the prompt with every placeholder standing, whatever is filled in — the switched-on keywords included. Works even with required fields empty. Ctrl+Shift+Enter.
prompt.copied_raw: Copied to the clipboard with placeholders.
prompt.copied_workbench: Version for this one use copied to the clipboard.
prompt.copy_blocked: Fill in the required fields first.
prompt.copy_manual_hint: The finished prompt is here, ready to select and copy.
prompt.unknown_keys: The text contains placeholders with no details: {keys}. They stay exactly as they are.
prompt.undone: The last change has been taken back.
prompt.workbench_hint: Here you can adapt the prompt for a single use without changing it. The button below the field copies what stands in it. The stored prompt stays as it is — lasting changes belong in the editor.
prompt.rejected_keys: These are not variables and cannot be filled in: {keys}. A name starts with a letter and holds letters, digits and underscores.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.intro: A keyword is a block of text placed before or after a prompt. When a prompt is used, each one can be switched on individually.
keywords.empty_hint: Create the first block of text — an instruction that should stand before every prompt, for instance.
keywords.text_hint: This text is inserted when the keyword is switched on.
keywords.order_hint: Smaller numbers stand further out. With equal numbers the name decides.
keywords.effect_hint: This is how a prompt looks with this keyword switched on.
keywords.example_body: Summarise the following passage in three sentences.
keywords.delete_hint: The keyword is attached to {count} prompts. Those assignments are dropped; the prompt texts stay unchanged.
keywords.delete_hint_none: No prompt uses this keyword. Deleting it cannot be undone.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.personal_note: This is your personal workspace. It can be renamed, but neither deleted nor given further members.
workspace.new_hint: You become the owner and can take members on afterwards.
workspace.created: “{name}” has been created and is now selected.
workspace.role_changed: The role of {name} has been changed.
workspace.email_hint: The account has to exist already. New accounts are created by the instance administration.
workspace.delete_hint: Every prompt, keyword and tag of this workspace is deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
workspace.delete_confirm_hint: The contents go with it. Type the name “{name}” to confirm.

trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Deleted prompts stay here for 30 days and can be fetched back until then.
trash.heading: Deleted prompts ({count})
trash.purge_hint: The prompt and its revisions are removed at once. This cannot be undone.
trash.empty_hint: Prompts you delete land here — and this is where you fetch them back.
trash.closed_hint: Seeing the trash needs the role of editor at least.
trash.bulk_purge_hint: They are removed beyond recovery, together with their revisions. This action cannot be undone.
trash.bulk_refused_unnamed: {count} not dealt with — they are not visible to you.

transfer.title: Import and export
transfer.intro: Keep prompts as a file, pass them on, or bring them in from a file. Every import is preceded by a preview.
transfer.format_json_hint: Complete — with keyword definitions and timestamps. The format for a move.
transfer.format_markdown_hint: One readable file per prompt. Without timestamps and without keyword definitions — for filing, not for moving.
transfer.file_hint: A JSON export file or a single Markdown file.
transfer.ambiguous: Title exists here {count} times — overwriting cannot be chosen
transfer.keywords_new: These keywords will be newly created: {names}
transfer.keywords_missing: These keywords are missing here and will not be assigned: {names}
transfer.unknown_fields: Unknown fields were not taken over: {names}
transfer.nothing_allowed: In this workspace you may neither export nor import. That needs the role of editor at least.
transfer.decided_partly: {count} entries do not offer this choice and were left unchanged.
transfer.plan: The import creates {added}, overwrites {overwrite}, creates {copy} as copies and skips {skip}.
transfer.keywords_conflicts: These keywords already exist here. The default is to skip, which leaves the existing version untouched.

profile.title: Profile
profile.forced_hint: Your password was reset by the administration. Until you have chosen one of your own, the application is locked.
profile.password_hint: At least 12 characters. Length counts for more than special characters.
profile.password_mismatch: The two entries do not match.
profile.disclosure_hint: Everything this instance has stored about you, as a JSON file: account, memberships, your own prompts including their content, favourites and the log entries that concern you.
profile.disclosure_done: The personal data report has been downloaded.
profile.language_hint: Applies to this account on every device. “Follow the browser” takes what this instance or your browser asks for.

admin.title: Administration
admin.initial_password_hint: This password is shown exactly once and stored nowhere in the clear. Pass it on by a route you consider safe; the person has to change it on first sign-in.
admin.reset_hint: Every session of this account is dropped at once. You receive a one-time password that is shown exactly once.
admin.delete_hint: The account is removed. Decide what should happen to the {count} prompts — this cannot be undone.
admin.audit_hint: Actions on this instance. Entries cannot be changed.
admin.settings_hint: These values take effect at once — no restart is needed. Address, port, paths and the trusted proxies are deliberately not here; they describe the machine and are maintained in config/config.yml.
admin.choice_off: Off — only the administration creates accounts
admin.choice_approval: With approval — the administration lets each one in
admin.choice_open: Open — whoever registers is in straight away
admin.setting_security_registration_hint: An account sees everything shared instance-wide — this switch opens not only the sign-up but that whole stock.
admin.setting_security_registrations_per_hour: New accounts per address and hour
admin.setting_security_registrations_per_hour_: Slows down mass creation. With a reverse proxy in front, it has to be entered in config.yml, or every request counts towards one address.
admin.setting_security_login_attempts_per_acco: After that the account is locked for a while.
admin.setting_security_login_attempts_per_ip_h: Take care with a shared company connection: everybody there shares this allowance.
admin.setting_security_lockout_minutes: Length of the lock in minutes
admin.setting_security_lockout_minutes_hint: Applies to both limits and at the same time as the window over which they are counted.
admin.setting_retention_revisions_per_prompt_h: A storage limit. The minimum period below takes precedence.
admin.setting_retention_revisions_min_days_hin: A promise: you can go back this far in any case, even if that means more revisions than allowed above.
admin.setting_retention_trash_days_hint: After that, deleted prompts are gone for good.
admin.setting_retention_audit_months_hint: Calendar months, not blocks of 30 days.
admin.setting_retention_audit_max_entries_hint: The last brake before a full file system. Once it is reached, the oldest entries disappear.
admin.setting_retention_login_attempts_days_hi: Needed only for the locking logic.
admin.kind_positive_integer: Expected: a whole number greater than 0.
admin.kind_non_negative_integer: Expected: a whole number from 0 upwards.
admin.kind_registration_mode: Expected: one of the offered possibilities.

selection.title: Selection
selection.too_many: {count} matches are too many for one action. Narrow the search down.
selection.dropped: The selection was cleared because the list changed.
